history.summary: Compact 463 sqft 1BR in a young 2021 D03 leasehold within walking distance of Queenstown MRT and the Greater Southern Waterfront catchment. Priced at $2,052 psf, roughly 8% below the $2,241 URA median, with a deep RCR location but only soft 2.4%/yr resale appreciation.
history.rating_rationale: RCR D03 location with GSW and TEL tailwinds, healthy 83-txn liquidity base, young 2021 build, and a sub-median PSF entry ($2,052 vs $2,241 median). Score 664 supports the technical case. Appreciation has been modest at 2.4%/yr which caps it below Strong Buy, but a small-quantum sub-$1M 1BR in a prime-adjacent RCR district is a liquid, defensible entry.

history.summary: MCL Land 40-storey project (99yr, TOP 2021) at 20 Margaret Drive, Queenstown D3, ~10-min walk to Commonwealth & Queenstown MRT. The 463 sqft 1BR at $2,052 psf ($950k) is verified below recent same-size resale comps — a genuine, not phantom, bargain.
history.rating_rationale: Verified value: a directly comparable 463 sqft 1BR transacted at $2,225 psf ($1.03M) in Mar 2025, and a live same-size listing sits at $2,376 psf — so the dossier asking of $2,052 psf is a real ~8-13% discount to recent matched comps, corroborating the algo's -15.3% age-adj / -5.1% vs cohort. Newer asset (2021) so minimal lease/maintenance drag. Queenstown is a premium RCR rental location with two EWL stations and strong tenant demand (one-north, CBD, NUH/Holland). Held to Buy not Strong Buy because cohort depth is modest (5 txns), D3 is RCR (not the top-forward OCR), and trailing 2.43% CAGR is weak/non-predictive — the case rests on the verified value gap, which is exactly the v3.4-preferred signal.
red_flags: psf_cohort_txns only 5 — discount is corroborated by web comps but on a thin internal sample
Tower-only layout with limited ground space; Stacked review notes it is not ideal for families (matters less for a 1BR investment)
99-yr leasehold (from ~2017) and an investor-heavy 1BR stack means exit competes with similar units
catalysts: ~10-min walk to two EWL stations (Commonwealth + Queenstown) in a top RCR rental belt
Verified same-size resale comps ($2,225-$2,376 psf) sit clearly above the asking — value re-rating room
Queenstown estate rejuvenation / proximity to one-north and Greater Southern Waterfront long-term upside
